description: This file declares interfaces for the Bmc2 Com Executor Helper API, including functions for validating, reading, opening, and retrieving template names related to the Bmc2 Com Executor object within the Broadway Management Console v2.0 implementation.

methods.name: Bmc2ComeoReaderValid
methods.description: Checks whether the reader object is valid.

methods.name: Bmc2ComeoReaderRead
methods.description: Reads data from the reader object into a buffer, returning the number of bytes read.

methods.name: Bmc2ComeoReaderOpenExternal
methods.description: Opens a resource externally by name.

methods.name: Bmc2ComeoReaderOpenInternal
methods.description: Opens an internal resource with specified content.

methods.name: Bmc2ComeoReaderGetTemplateName
methods.description: Retrieves the template name associated with the reader.
